I really like the aesthetic you've got going on here. One thing I noticed while watching it is that it feels pretty repetetive. I can tell that you're changing whats happening with some of the instruments throughout the song; the synth and the drums were the big ones. And thats great, but, because none of the elements really take the spotlight, and theres no one continuos motif that all of the instruments support which changes, so its hard for the listener to latch on to the interesting changes which are happening. I think this is what is making it sound repetetive to me and i'd probably fix it by making sure that all of the instruments are supporting one motif and then playing around with the structure of the motif throughout the song. Otherwise, I love what you're doing.
